newsitem.title: USA: Big Board committee proposes easing Rule 500 - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Big Board committee proposes easing Rule 500 - WSJ.

text.p: An advisory committee of the New York Stock Exchange is proposing that the exchange ease its Rule 500, which makes it almost impossible for companies to leave the exchange, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
Under the proposal, a company could delist with the approval of its own board, the paper said.
The current rule requires a two-thirds majority vote of all shareholders, with no more than 10 percent objecting.
A Big Board legal advisory committe examining Rule 500 concluded that the rule needs to be substantially revised or abandoned altogether, the Journal said.
